answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that sits locked like shale for 30 epochs before it can grade or earn. If peers catch two identities sharing one key cipher or signing pattern, both bonds are slashed and paid to the reporter. A farm of 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 bonds up front and risks losing all of them, so the plume of fake accounts costs far more than any reward it could extract.
